name: AlphaNet
summary: Melbourne dialup ISP since 1995; pivoted to VoIP/hosting/IT services, still active (ALPHANET PTY. LTD., ACN 068 104 058).

events.details: Melbourne dialup ISP (Doncaster, VIC 3109 per ABR); now VoIP/hosting/IT solutions + managed services. Earliest Wayback capture 6 Jun 1997.

Pivoted from consumer dialup ISP to VoIP/hosting/IT services; AlphaNet Pty Ltd still trading (alphanet.com.au, 'At your service since 1995', © 2026). Prior 'death c.2005' record was fabricated boilerplate and has been removed.
